== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|The Nightwyrm is a powerful entity associated with the [[Kameira]]. It possesses exceptional physical constitution and is described as being soulbound to the awakened tail of a Stormwing, making it an extremely hazardous creature that requires extreme caution when approached. The Nightwyrm's power is contained within a specific individual, and its presence can cause physical spasms in the host. It is one of many [[Kameira]] powers that have urged their host to flee.}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|This entity resides within [[Meia]] and acts as an internal force that urges her to retreat. It also demands that she face challenges head-on.}}

== Of Shadow and Sea ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|[[Alchemists]] have long claimed to be able to offer the constitution of a Nightwyrm, which is identified as a type of [[Kameira]]. This entity exists inside [[Meia]], where it causes physical spasms beneath her skin. While the Nightwyrm urges [[Meia]] to retreat from her struggles, it also demands that she meet her challenges head-on.}}
